meaning: Some concrete candidate exists at w, by the existing Round 4 activity derivation (inhabitedFromProduction, imported and applied), with the owner-approved floor commitment STMT-CAUSAL-POWER-AND-ACTIVITY-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS (capacity and activity clauses at the same w, on the same Causes and concrete) supplying the activity clause that the old argument took as the bare premise STMT-CAUSERS-REQUIRE-CONCRETENESS-AT. The other five premises are unchanged and remain OPEN; the contested production of an inner word (STMT-INTELLECTUAL-EXERCISE-PRODUCES-AT) is still required. It does not establish the floor commitment, which rests on its owner approval, and it says nothing about what concreteness is beyond the supplied predicate.
